  dverse whoami      [--env <name>]             verify connection; print user and org
  dverse model sync --entities a,b [--env <name>]   refresh dataverse.snapshot.json from metadata
  dverse plan  [--json] [--no-prune] [--no-build] [--all] [--assembly <dll>] [--package [--package-id <id>]] [--env <name>]

               covers everything configured, a project directory just that project; --all widens
               to the full config from anywhere
                                             diff desired vs live registration (exit 0 = clean, 2 = changes)
  dverse apply [--no-prune] [--no-build] [--no-batch] [--no-bump] [--all] [--assembly <dll>] [--package [--package-id <id>]] [--env <name>]
                                             push assembly + registration to the environment
               --package: deploy as a plugin package (nupkg with dependent assemblies); inferred from the
               project's <DversePluginPackage>/<DversePackageId> properties when omitted; id defaults to
               the assembly name; --package-id implies --package
               --no-batch: one request per write instead of parallel $batch changesets
               --no-bump:  skip the automatic source-version increment on content changes
                           (AssemblyVersion revision / PCF manifest patch — commit the bumped files)
  dverse adopt --assembly <name> [--env <name>] [--out <file.cs>] [--namespace <ns>] [--force]

                                             Ids pinned (read-only; de

dverse — declarative Dataverse plugin deployment

  dverse auth login  [--env <name>]             interactive device-code sign-in
